mentions.name: LLM-based D&D system prototype
mentions.description: A small prototype that applies large language models to video games, implementing a Dungeons & Dragons–style system powered by LLMs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m exploring ways to apply LLMs to video games and have built a small prototype of an LLM-based D&D system.
